svg.title: Jatinkumar Parmar — AI Engineer / Agentic AI Architect

g.text: I love Mahakal — we believe the word AI is an extension of ShivaY: intent, made intelligent.
Dedicated to building agentic AI systems that are strong, scalable and add real value.
🔭 Building autonomous agent systems, RAG pipelines and n8n automations for 10+ years
🤝 Runs an AI automation agency and does pro-bono AI consulting for non-profits & startups
📚 Reviewed 14+ technical AI/ML books · maintains 900+ repos on GitHub
